newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN BUDGET MINISTER WANTS NEW POST - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN BUDGET MINISTER WANTS NEW POST - PAPER.

text.p: Belgian Budget Minister Herman Van Rompuy told Belgian daily Het Laatste Nieuws on Thursday that he would like a different post in the next government.

Asked whether he planned to stay in the budget ministry, he said "No, I want to do something different." He declined to be Van Rompuy, who has been named as a possible successor to Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene, is in his second term as budget minister.
